test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five persons Abi, Raj, Brij, Ritz and Das are sitting on a ladder one above the other (not necessarily in the same order). Raj sits immediately above Ritz. Ritz is immediately above Abi. Only two persons sit between Ritz and Das. If Das sits below Abi, then how many persons will sit between Das and Raj?
solution:
**Given: **Five persons Abi, Raj, Brij, Ritz and Das are sitting on a ladder one above the other (not necessarily in the same order). 

**Explanation:**

According to the given statements,

1) Raj sits immediately above Ritz. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30609897747b3f39ac38a8780adbd3fc232a1e2a4680b77770c6e8dc27c5f1be.png] 

2) Ritz is immediately above Abi. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41eaa80e8f728b68eecdbf2780a732ead5583c836839bc471908c8ab01396dc0.png] 

So, case-4 is eliminated.

3) Only two persons sit between Ritz and Das. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/194a631d1d2d2b261f41c441d5b1d6cf83ebc7574b38a035bd7ff60f18f26d63.png] 

So, case 2 is eliminated.

Thus, the final sitting arrangement on a ladder is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4909065180fb7c1aedc4b1d17117bfe59ff7a13d7a25ecfcc86f467afa2ebc30.png] 

So, we have two cases of sitting.

Next, if Das sits below Abi, then the sitting arrangement will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2140acc246df3754e8c7dabddbdb3e0e99499e89fb4d1df7e8e4b5288105edf0.png] 

Thus, there are '**three**' persons who will sit between Das and Raj.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'option 2'.**
